<<Cleaning A Telescope Mirror, Briefly>>  

Regular cleaning of a telescope mirror is essential to maintain optimal viewing performance. Use a soft, lint-free cloth or a gentle cleaning solution to wipe away dust, dirt, and debris. Avoid using harsh chemicals or abrasive materials that may scratch the mirror surface. Always work in a clean, dry environment to prevent recontamination. Regular maintenance ensures clearer images and a more enjoyable stargazing experience for all.
